verdict.rationale: Pomelo documents a built-in AI assistant, but it is scoped to answering questions about the Pomelo API in the developer docs. Nothing shows it carrying out delegated tasks inside the product, such as issuing cards or managing transactions in the Dashboard. The MCP server is a separate external-agent capability and is not credited here. Missing for 10: evidence of task execution (not just Q&A) by the assistant, an assistant embedded in the operational Dashboard, documentation of the assistant's scope and actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Asistente de inteligencia artificial para consultas sobre la API de Pomelo
